title: TQue DMA Double Buffering enables compute/memory overlap
technique: TQue<VECIN> + TQue<VECOUT> with depth=2 for double-buffered DMA
lesson: Using TQue with depth=2 allows overlapping data transfer with computation. While one tile is being computed, the next tile's data is being DMA'd in. This is essential for matmul-like kernels on Ascend NPU.
